item: 3.7 deny with a message on tool cards — the plan card's feedback field, inline after Reject on every ordinary permission card (2026-09-05)
branch: cardBtns appends a `.plan-fb` input (placeholder "Tell Claude what to do instead") inside `.card-b` after the Reject button; done() reads it on deny only (an ordinary allow drops it — Kotlin forwards `feedback` on allow solely for plans, where it rides updatedInput.plan; measured 2.1.233), the text rides the bridge `perm` message as `text` and Kotlin sends it as the deny `message` (existing path, RenderLimits.REJECT_MESSAGE when empty). Enter in the field rejects with the note. The decided line quotes the note through fbQuote, exactly as the plan card does. The plan card is untouched: its field stays above the buttons with its own placeholder.
provenance: Frame shapes are the CLI's (`can_use_tool` → the panel's permission_request; docs/ide-mcp-protocol.md). The deny message reaching the model VERBATIM as the tool_result, and a `feedback` field on allow being dropped, were both probed on 2.1.233 (2026-08-16, protocol doc § permission facts). VS Code 2.1.260 renders the same input beside its reject button (webview/index.js `rejectMessageInput`, placeholder "Tell Claude what to do instead"). Negative control on the pre-3.7 build (the 2.12 sandbox): no `.plan-fb` exists on an ordinary card, so the typed-note asserts read 'absent' and the tape's text is '' — DISCRIMINATING; the empty-reject and plan-card asserts are GUARDS that must pass on both builds.
